sv.title: Skandalscener i Europa League – match avbröts
sv.summary: Europa League-mötet mellan turkiska Besiktas och israeliska Hapoel Beer-Sheva fick avbrytas sedan den turkiska klubbens fans drabbat samman med polis.

en.title: Scenes of scandal in Europa League – match interrupted
en.summary: The Europa League match between Turkish Besiktas and Israeli Hapoel Beer-Sheva had to be stopped after the Turkish club's fans clashed with police.
